failure_modes: This business resists valuation: annual revenue growth is typically 24 points away from its 28%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 8 points away from its 0% average — what cannot be valued must be avoided however cheap it looks.
The cash engine fell 92% from its 2017-12-31 peak to its 2018-12-31 trough and has since regained that peak — a cyclical engine, not a broken one.

The cash engine bent when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock took owner earnings 56% below the prior peak (2020-12-31) and it came back; the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 91% below the prior peak (2022-12-31) and it came back.
